items.title: Add receipt proof client and verifier
items.context: Add AuthorityClient proof fetch, proof schema, trusted key/digest handling, signature verification, inputDigest and decisionDigest recomputation, production key classification, and precise fail reasons.
items.userSees: Running lattice authority receipt verify on a valid proof prints: Receipt verification: PASS receiptVerified=true classification=production-gate-decision receiptId=<id> decisionDigest=<sha256>.

happy.desc: A valid server proof with hex key/signature verifies and classifies production-gate-decision.

edge.desc: A local-test/default server key verifies cryptographically but is classified server-receipt-local-test.

adversarial.desc: Corrupt signature, input payload, decision payload, story, phase, head, or material mismatch returns a machine-readable failure and writes no production ref.

verificationEvidence.note: Valid gate_decision proof verifies with hex public key/signature only when caller supplies a pinned production authority key digest; result classifies production-gate-decision and exposes receiptId/inputDigest/decisionDigest.
Cryptographically valid local/default/test receipt remains server-receipt-local-test and productionReady=false.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-receipt-proof-smoke.js && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-receipt-classification && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-runner-contracts && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-client && git diff --check -- packages/main/src/core/authority-client.ts packages/main/src/core/authority-gate-receipt-verifier.ts packages/main/src/tasks/authority-receipt-proof-smoke.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts untrusted production-looking key, corrupt signature, input digest mismatch, decision digest mismatch, story/phase/head/material mismatch, and server-relative proof fetch guard; existing Authority receipt and client contracts still pass.

items.title: Add receipt-ref writer command and store support
items.context: Expose lattice authority receipt verify, write authority-receipt-refs.json only for production gate_decision receipts, preserve previous refs, and keep invalid/local-test diagnostics non-gating.
items.userSees: After verification, the command prints: Receipt ref: PASS path=.koala/story/actives/<storyId>/authority-receipt-refs.json receiptId=<id> status=active.

happy.desc: A production gate_decision proof writes one active receipt ref and preserves prior refs.

edge.desc: Re-verifying the same receipt id replaces or preserves one ref without duplicating records.

adversarial.desc: Invalid, contract-only, transport-accepted, or local-test receipts do not write production-gate-decision refs.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-receipt-proof && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-receipts
verificationEvidence.note: Valid production gate_decision proof with caller-pinned production authority key digest writes one active authority-receipt-refs.json ref through StoryStore; receipt ref includes targetPhase, decisionVerdict, digest, status, and path.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-receipt-proof && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-receipts
verificationEvidence.note: Proof smoke asserts re-verifying the same receipt id leaves refs.length=1, and gate receipt smoke covers upsert/eligibility behavior without duplicate active refs.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-receipt-proof && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-boundary-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-evidence-flow && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-enforce-matrix && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Local-test/untrusted/invalid proofs remain diagnostic-only and written=false; missing storyId/index is rejected before proof load so no orphan receipt refs are created; Codex and Claude read-only follow-up audits both PASS the owner-lease missing-story fix.

items.title: Wire idempotent TEST gate consumption
items.context: Read authority-receipt-refs.json during validate or TEST gate enforcement, consume matching receipts idempotently, derive strongEvidenceConsumed only from the gate adapter, and preserve local/shadow behavior by default.
items.userSees: In enforce mode, lattice validate --story=<storyId> prints: Authority gate consumption: PASS strongEvidenceConsumed=true receiptId=<id> gate=TEST.

happy.desc: A matching TEST receipt ref is consumed and output names strongEvidenceConsumed=true and the receipt id.

edge.desc: Shadow mode reports missing or invalid Authority receipt diagnostics without blocking local validation.

adversarial.desc: Enforce mode blocks missing, stale, wrong phase, wrong story, wrong head, or wrong material receipt refs.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption
verificationEvidence.note: Matching TEST gate_decision receipt is consumed by validate and transition gate; output includes strongEvidenceConsumed=true with receiptId=AR-TEST; repeated validate and transition consumption leave consumptionEvents.length=1.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-receipts
verificationEvidence.note: Shadow mode reports diagnostics without blocking or writing receipt refs; eligibleGates restriction is enforced for same-phase TEST receipts; TEST receipt can cover DONE only when eligibleGates explicitly includes DONE.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-receipts && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-receipt-proof && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-evidence-flow && git diff --check
verificationEvidence.note: Enforce mode blocks missing receipt and phase mismatch; proof and evidence-flow smokes cover stale/mismatched receipt paths. Codex CLI found eligibleGates same-phase blocker, fix applied and verified; Claude and Codex targeted rechecks both PASS.

items.title: Wire DONE gate policy and status output
items.context: Require distinct DONE receipt unless policy allows TEST coverage, re-check head/material before DONE, show readiness/verified/consumed as separate facts, and prevent local diagnostic receipts from setting productionDone.
items.userSees: For DONE in enforce mode, story_advance --phase=DONE prints: Authority DONE gate: PASS receiptId=<id> gate=DONE, or blocks with authority_receipt_* reason.

happy.desc: A distinct DONE receipt allows DONE gate consumption and output names the consumed receipt id.

edge.desc: A TEST receipt covers DONE only when policy explicitly allows cross-phase coverage.

adversarial.desc: DONE blocks stale material, missing receipt, or a TEST receipt when cross-phase coverage is not configured.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption
verificationEvidence.note: Distinct DONE gate_decision receipt is consumed by the DONE transition gate and output includes Authority DONE gate: PASS strongEvidenceConsumed=true story=B-done gate=DONE receiptId=AR-DONE.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-receipts
verificationEvidence.note: TEST receipt is refused for DONE unless eligibleGates explicitly includes DONE; same-phase eligibleGates restriction is preserved; explicit TEST->DONE coverage passes only with eligibleGates=[TEST,DONE].

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-receipts && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-receipt-proof && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-evidence-flow && git diff --check
verificationEvidence.note: Enforce mode blocks missing and wrong-phase refs; receipt helper/proof smokes cover stale material/head/story/phase mismatch. DONE gate reads current root head/material before phase mutation, shadow/off do not persist strongEvidenceConsumed, and Claude/Codex CHK-004 read-only audits both PASS.

items.title: Separate Authority receipt status and operator feedback
items.context: Render Authority readiness, latest verified receipt ref, eligibility, and consumed receipt as distinct status facts. This item exists because INIT reviewers flagged that status output should be separate from DONE gate policy wiring.
items.userSees: lattice status or authority status prints separate lines for authorityReady, receiptVerified, receiptEligible, receiptConsumed, and productionDone without collapsing readiness into completion.

happy.desc: Status output distinguishes configured, verified, eligible, and consumed Authority receipt states.

edge.desc: A verified but unconsumed receipt is shown as verified, not consumed.

adversarial.desc: Local diagnostic receipts and transport accepted responses keep receiptVerified=false, authorityChanged=false, and productionDone=false.

items.title: Write Layer 2 proof bridge execution plan
items.context: Document the minimum correctness-preserving path from local Engineering baseline diagnostics to legitimate Layer 2 proof without turning host transcripts or L0 diagnostic artifacts into capability proof.
items.userSees: A new Lattice-Layer2-Proof-Bridge-Execution-Plan.md document explains the implementation sequence, proof boundaries, host roles, gates, tests, and PASS criteria.

happy.desc: The document defines a concrete development sequence from Development proof ingestion to Engineering suite PASS without claiming Loop or Production safety.

edge.desc: The document distinguishes Lattice CLI non-authority local diagnostics from Authority-backed proof and lifecycle-backed proof.

adversarial.desc: The document explicitly forbids setting localOnly=false or capabilityProof=true from host transcripts, local diagnostic receipts, or manual JSON edits.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "baseline_development_proof_import|baseline_proof_create|Engineering suiteStatus = PASS|Loop claim authorized = false|Production Safety claim authorized = false" Lattice-Layer2-Proof-Bridge-Execution-Plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document defines the concrete implementation sequence from Development proof import through Engineering suite PASS while preserving higher-layer claim blocks.
Document distinguishes local diagnostic CLI output, lifecycle-backed proof, and Authority-backed proof.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Do not make .*baseline_run.*capabilityProof=true|Do not edit JSON artifacts by hand|No host transcript or local diagnostic report can become proof by relabeling|raw Claude/Codex transcript without manifest|local diagnostic receipt" Lattice-Layer2-Proof-Bridge-Execution-Plan.md && git diff --check -- Lattice-Layer2-Proof-Bridge-Execution-Plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document explicitly forbids relabeling local diagnostics, host transcripts, or manual JSON edits into formal proof.
